query:
-- Re-add tags to projects that failed before
-- Bell, Book, and Candle
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Bell, Book, and Candle' AND t.name IN ('Witchcraft')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- The Merry Wives of Windsor
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'The Merry Wives of Windsor' AND t.name IN ('Elizabethan', 'Farce')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- An Inspector Calls
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
